activity_options.title: Station Jigsaw Synthesis Matrix: Democratic Governance
activity_options.description: Students use station jigsaw synthesis matrix to explore 'Investigates information on the beginning and progress of public services.'. Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
activity_options.student_action_summary: Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
activity_options.teacher_facilitation_summary: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
activity_options.student_grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
activity_options.expected_student_output: A group civic proposal, diagram, or public information message.
activity_options.creative_assessment_preview: Groups give one-sentence feedback connecting a peer proposal to the outcome.
activity_options.low_resource_alternative: Use spoken prompts and notebook pages if printed or display materials are unavailable.
learning_outcomes_addressed: Investigates information on the beginning and progress of public services.
